limitations: Bounding boxes checked only for integer range, positive extent and schema legality; no image rendering or full pixel review.

Request count, freshness, model identity and serial execution are corroborated from frozen code and persisted local evidence, not live network monitoring or cryptographic remote attestation.
No outstanding requests or extra stages means within this experiment filesystem; unrelated external services/processes were not contacted or inspected.
Matching beginning/end hashes detects persistent changes during this audit, not hypothetical transient changes restored between reads.
